blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Here are INQToday’s top stories this afternoon: Gasoline prices are set to drop by P4.30 per liter on Tuesday, while diesel prices will increase by P2.60 per liter; the Department of Foreign Affairs says no Filipinos have been reported harmed in protests in France and Italy; and Sen. Raffy Tulfo has overtaken Sen. Robin Padilla as the most preferred senatorial candidate for the 2028 elections, according to the latest Octa Research survey./dp READ: Raffy Tulfo overtakes Padilla in Octa’s 2028 Senate survey...
